classification: Original public synthetic static qualification candidate; no product writer or operational credential

rights.origin: Original synthetic profile and expected literals; original authority package retains its existing rights

original_package.reason: Independent rule explanation, never an internal exception name or mandatory first-failure ordering
original_package.unchanged_expected: Every exact original decision, registered code/status, disclosure projection, complete after-state, marker attribution, preallocated input identity and product-empty observation remains mandatory.

consumer_boundary.normalization: Server-internal authenticated executor identity, exact selected workspace/resource/action/purpose and immutable chain identity; not an HTTP caller-supplied projection
consumer_boundary.runtime_input: Only each original or supplemental case input, independently selected trusted configuration and separately supplied trusted clock. No expected object, reason, case identity, oracle metadata or result-dependent branch reaches runtime.
consumer_boundary.semantics: Bounded current PostgreSQL rows feed the accepted pure evaluator. An immutable observation grants no reusable authority. Actual final transaction must independently reread and fence before any isolated marker/CAS. A held fence must repeat the complete locked current check with its originating trusted clock immediately before each effect.
consumer_boundary.writers: Only isolated synthetic marker and explicitly selected synthetic CAS. Product command receipts, product effects and human assurance stay empty/false. Every product/bootstrap writer remains disabled pending its independent lifecycle gate. Resource CAS additionally requires the admitted project.change.review action; project.read cannot advance control.

native_profile.transport: Protected owned Unix socket only; no TCP/ambient DSN/password file or PG* variables
native_profile.ceiling_semantics: Original fixture ceilings do not raise ordinary 500ms/2s budgets; actual each transaction and observed wait must satisfy the narrower selected profile.
native_profile.cohorts: Two complete unfiltered new native targets authority_current then authority_races precede existing qualification in the collector's sorted (package,kind,name) execution order. New targets do not restart PostgreSQL, retain the exact initial readiness identity throughout, close all owned handles and reset only owned roles/database between cases. The unchanged old qualification target runs last, including its one measured restart. Never reuse the initial readiness after that restart; any later run requires freshly bound input. Every target runs serially; no test filtering, batch bypass or old case removal. Verify actual complete collector ordering in the transcript. At most two combined ordinary/admission/permission writer slots and three separately censused control connections.
native_profile.pooling: Single explicitly controlled direct qualification session set only; no per-request/per-tenant pools, general production pool or cross-process allocation qualification inferred.
native_profile.session_allocation: New cohort recreates its exact owned database with CONNECTION LIMIT2. Close all old-cohort ordinary handles and non-superuser setup/migrator sessions before serially opening the two concurrent writer slots. Admission and permission roles share those slots, including idle/cancelled/unknown handles; no replacement until exact previous owned close is established. S3 is a genuinely fresh independent backend after S1/S2 finish and explicit owned close/replace, not an assertion that only two lifetime PIDs exist. Admin seed/observer/controller remain separately accounted<=3; no admin decision/effect.
native_profile.database_limit_caveat: PostgreSQL17 documents approximate database connection-limit enforcement (concurrent last-slot starts can both fail) and exemptions for superusers/background workers. Positive opens serialize; retain real third-session denial and exact backend census. These observations and finite session allocation do not establish a universal pool bound.

storage.old_migrations: Preserve versions1-3 and checksums byte-exact. History remains exact successful prefix; four selected migrations require a five-row lookahead before changes.
storage.legacy: Forward additions retain nullable unclassified metadata for existing rows. Never infer human kind, policy roles, revision, time or authority; selected incomplete legacy data fails closed.
storage.identifiers: Existing checked UUIDv4 domain; tenant keys and consequential relationships have same-tenant composite constraints.

revisions.successor: Existing checked_next; exhaustion conflicts atomically before accepted marker/CAS.

storage.timestamps: Finite UTC milliseconds, years0001..9999, no submillisecond truncation, infinity, offset-profile inference or defaulting.
storage.arrays: Typed one-dimensional bounded arrays; no authority JSON blob, deduplication, truncation or cached inference.
storage.immutable_chain: Header and ordered complete typed member copies are persisted independently of mutable live grants. Current content must equal each sealed member at admission; no mutable join may fabricate the sealed snapshot.
storage.read_projection: Indexed exact selected/participating keys only, with33rd-row overflow detection and a global32-row allocation bound before materialization. Every variable-size selected scalar/array has a bounded SQL output guard before SQLx allocation. Malformed data is rejected, never hidden by LIMIT or default.

row_accounting.representation: Canonical fixture rows, two inert aliases, independent sealed members and one namespace parent; the expected post-admission peak separately allows accepted markers. Null financial events add no rows.
row_accounting.evidence_scope: Static expected peak footprint for each selected snapshot, including the eventual expected accepted-marker allowance. This is not an initial SQL census or seed prescription. Expected markers never seed any row or reach runtime. Realization separately lists input snapshot/before-marker counts and expected peak counts; actual SQL before/after census remains mandatory.
row_accounting.financial_null: The two original financial negatives select no event row. Observe disabled/no-event state without storing or constructing assurance; original null observation shape is not a new canonical event.

storage.physical_accounting: The owning resource profile retains32 canonical fixture rows including every alias, independent sealed member, namespace and accepted marker. Separately census at most four fixed successful migration receipts: normal v4 physical user rows<=36. This proposed36-row accounting requires actual native census; no prior qualification or raised32-row capacity is claimed. PostgreSQL system catalogues are separately observed. Intentional negative row/ledger lookahead temporarily exceeds its applicable boundary only with an explicit retained census and bounded restoration; arbitrary authority/audit data cannot be classified administrative.

order: global source-policy IDs and selected workspace policy
immutable chain header/members and live grant IDs
lock_protocol.key_order: Within each family use ascending canonical typed key order; permission writers use identical order. No unsafe SHARE-to-UPDATE target upgrade.
lock_protocol.namespace_parent: Acquire the one fixed namespace row in its own completed SQL statement BEFORE any authority/closure discovery. Admission takes FOR SHARE; every permission mutation takes FOR UPDATE first. A combined parent-lock/join statement is forbidden because a READ COMMITTED statement snapshot can predate the conflicting writer's COMMIT. Subsequent discovery and actual selected row locks use fresh statements; hold the parent until positive COMMIT/ROLLBACK. This fences missing/new/changed closure members while retaining all actual family/key locks. Global permission serialization is explicit, not a product performance claim.
lock_protocol.row_modes: FOR SHARE conflicts with non-key revocation UPDATE; KEY SHARE is insufficient. Review/CAS target takes its final exclusive mode up front.
lock_protocol.post_wait: Reread the complete selected closure after every wait under a fresh READ COMMITTED statement snapshot; sample the server-internal trusted clock after all waits. Never use transaction-start now() as a fresh clock. A caller-held fence must repeat final locked current reads and originating trusted-clock sampling before its marker/CAS, so time expiry cannot be hidden by an earlier observation.
lock_protocol.terminal: Only positive COMMIT/ROLLBACK is definite. Lost completion/drop/cancellation poisons the owned session; no reuse, automatic retry, fabricated rollback or marker receipt. Closing the exact owned session remains bounded.
lock_protocol.target_first_mode: Select SHARE for a read-only target or the final exclusive mode for any marker/CAS target at the first target acquisition. Never take SHARE then upgrade for a possible later CAS.
lock_protocol.child_lock_discrimination: Ordinary parent-first races cannot alone establish child locks. Separate bounded lock-only probes also share the parent, target each selected policy/source/org/domain/principal/membership/chain/member/grant/resource row, and prove actual conflicting tuple modes via exact backend blocking plus post-release acquisition. No permission mutation bypasses the parent. A parent-only or KEYSHARE substitute must fail; table-lock counts/query strings alone are insufficient.

role_boundary.ordinary: harness_writer retains SELECT-only privileges on its four original arboresce_authority relations and TenantSession READ ONLY. Its separate historical SELECT+INSERT on migration_harness.records also remains exact. It receives no new authority UPDATE privilege or membership.
role_boundary.flags: LOGIN, nonowner, NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION; no inherited membership of admin/migrator/writer/other authority role; no SET ROLE or migration connection in consumer.
role_boundary.readiness: Observe actual roles, exact table/column ACLs, forced RLS, policy command/role/USING/WITH CHECK, role membership and selected database; fixture flags are no authority.
role_boundary.context: Complete organization/domain/executor/selected_chain settings are transaction-local; selected_chain is one exact identity or empty, never a participant list. Missing/retained context fails closed. Participant visibility derives only from actual selected persisted immutable chain rows, includes revoked rows needed for truthful denial, and has no RLS recursion. Exact current executor remains separately readable even without membership.
role_boundary.lock_privilege: For lock-only relations grant only UPDATE(lock_guard), with role-specific permissive UPDATE USING exact closure and AS RESTRICTIVE UPDATE WITH CHECK(false). FOR SHARE/NO KEY UPDATE uses UPDATE-USING; actual guard DML remains denied even if a permissive UPDATE exists. Complete actual policy/column ACL validation still rejects an unexpected policy. Relations with separately admitted real control/state updates grant only those columns, no guard-column UPDATE.
role_boundary.effect_privilege: Only separately enumerated synthetic marker INSERT and target control CAS column update; scoped forced-RLS checks and exact typed relationships remain. Permission-role changes are separately enumerated and acquire the namespace UPDATE fence first. Immutable member mutation is not an ordinary role capability.
role_boundary.combined_budget: Exact static candidate selects separately recreated owned DB CONNECTION LIMIT2 plus finite preallocated two-concurrent-slot direct session set, serialized positive opens, explicit old/migrator close, actual combined-role/backend census and third-denial test. Cancelled/uncertain handle responsibilities remain occupied until exact close; S3 closes/replaces a prior slot with a new backend. Controls are separate<=3, cluster16. Exact source/controller/profile implementation still requires independent admission.
role_boundary.permission_protocol: Only four explicit synthetic permission entry variants are enabled: current membership revoke/revision, current grant revoke/revision/time, selected workspace-policy restriction/epoch and exact resource-control compare-and-increment. Their private transaction constructor first completes namespace FOR UPDATE then fresh current reads/key-ordered locks. No raw connection or unfenced transaction escapes the public API; every variant uses that constructor. INSERT/DELETE/TRUNCATE are ungranted; NO ACTION FKs prevent mutation cascades; sealed members cannot be edited. Other permission mutation capabilities remain unavailable pending their own gates. ACLs alone are not claimed to fence an arbitrary credential-holder SQL client.
role_boundary.restrictive_context: Add a role-specific AS RESTRICTIVE FOR ALL complete-context predicate to each relation for the new internal roles, including the four legacy tables. It ANDs with existing PUBLIC SELECT policies without changing their ordinary-role behavior. Missing organization/domain/executor must yield zero rows even where a legacy PUBLIC policy otherwise exposes the executor. selected_chain is an optional exact reference, never a participant list.

disclosure.status_projection: General current authentication/input/visibility/action/CAS stages must reproduce all72 exact registered status/code literals using actual SQL observations, never a fixture ID/reason special case.
disclosure.unknown_backend_or_stored_shape: Finite safe unavailable/invalid-stored-data outcome; SQL/binds/foreign IDs/counts/backend messages excluded.
disclosure.open_question: The staged internal rule above remains unaccepted until exact static SOURCE/EXPECTED/DISTINCT review; registered HTTP mapping remains a separate later consumer gate.
disclosure.scope: Internal normalized synthetic admission failure/observation projections only. They are not HTTP response bodies or registered route acceptance. The project_change.review operation inventory currently omits not_found, while an original normalized synthetic fixture expects404. Preserve original literal and gate later wire adaptation against its owning registration; do not add a wire error, silently alter old fixtures, or claim unchanged registered review response.
disclosure.permission_before_cas: Check current authentication, normalized input and target disclosure, then all current action/source/chain permission before exposing client CAS conflict. The accepted pure evaluator checks CAS earlier and cannot be directly mapped to409 on mixed denial. A trusted permission-only call using current observed control may discard its observation, followed by original client CAS comparison and final original-request evaluation; exact algorithm and literal mixed-denial expectations require separate static admission. No stale/unauthorized combination may reveal revision state.
stages: Validate bounded normalized input: missing explicit workspace or supplied authorizer claim is InvalidRequest.

Resolve the exact current executor row with supported identity/kind and active current state; absent/revoked/unsupported executor is Unauthenticated. This remains normalized synthetic identity observation, not signature qualification.

Resolve exact selected active organization/domain, current executor membership with supported selected policy/read role, actual resource and current executor source-audience visibility. Unknown/inaccessible membership/policy/source/resource is NotFound, with no foreign identifier/count.

When a selected persisted chain has a recognized exact root target, intersect target visibility with that root's exact resource scope. An exact different root target is NotFound. Unknown/malformed chain is not an authority grant and proceeds only to bounded permission denial; never infer visibility from names.

After target visibility, check request purpose and full current direct/chain authority, including every issuer/subject current principal/membership/source intersection, immutable content/order/parent/delegability/lifetime and supported interpretation/policy. Failures here are Forbidden.

Only after complete current authority compare the original caller's required target control. A mismatch/exhaustion is Conflict. Then independently evaluate the original normalized request against the same final locked current projection before an isolated marker/CAS.

An intermediate permission-only pure call may use the actual observed current control to neutralize the pure evaluator's earlier CAS branch; discard that observation. It neither changes the original request nor supplies a reusable capability or success result. Exact fixture review must admit this algorithm before consumption.
Fresh final fence repeats current visibility/action/CAS after separately committed preparation changes; prior observations never authorize it.

review_status: STATIC CANDIDATE pending exact independent SOURCE/EXPECTED/DISTINCT admission and normal local delivery. This package does not qualify a runtime, schema, controller or remaining obligation.

reading_limits.paths: Only the exact five regular relative package files, no symlink/unknown/missing/duplicate/outside paths

crates/arboresce-postgres/src/migration..scope: Exact accepted pre-implementation migration-source context only, retained as inert public evidence. It is not the current consumer and is never executed. Current consumer bytes require fresh independent source/native/standalone qualification; original SQL1-3 and their applied history remain exact.

authority_races.selection: Independent shared trusted synthetic test configuration for every original authority_races input, selected only by initial-snapshot versus live-current/permission/final phase. Each live adapter read/effect samples the supplied Clock after waits. The final complete SQL-state observer also makes an actual trusted Clock call after both positive terminals/owned closes. Never read expected after.now, case identity, decision or revoked_at to choose a sample. This is no ambient wall-clock, production time or scheduler-duration claim.

reader_failure.phase: after all required tuple waits and locked reads
reader_failure.source: Independent trusted qualification configuration, never an untrusted request field
reader_failure.scope: Injected dependency result only, not a host-clock fault or observed SQL transport cause

boundary_supplement.classification: Static independent literal boundary inputs; no executed or accepted runtime
boundary_supplement.helper_guard_scope: Profile representations, bounded owned temporary PID files and pre-effect constructor rejection only; no native server-profile/identity/race evidence
boundary_supplement.consumer_protocol: Only each input and separately selected trusted configuration enter producers; expected objects, fixture IDs and reasons remain in assertions. No threshold, exclusions, budgets or original decisions change.
boundary_supplement.cardinality_case_scope: Repeated17 purposes qualify composite oversize-plus-duplicate rejection, not an isolated cardinality discriminator; existing16-element policy and unique-subset caps remain.

decoder_completion_supplement.classification: Static independent literal inputs, no runtime acceptance
decoder_completion_supplement.cleanup: Validate constructor operation/layout/PID and bounds before owned filesystem effects. Unexpected later setup/cleanup failure still fails the test; do not substitute it for a declared guard result.
decoder_completion_supplement.real_scope: Legacy partial metadata and exact single-CHECK faults, range-valid ordinal continuity, actual same-count required-column identity, injected trusted Clock result. Structured MigrateError and constructor records have separate representation-only attribution.
decoder_completion_supplement.no_waiver: All original budgets, roles, reading/row/storage/clock/connection caps, strict standard coverage, actual dual-lane/native/model/probe/resource/retention/conservation/cleanup/review/normal delivery and real-input requirements remain. No next-run coverage gain or completion is promised.
